headline: You Know Who Really Hates AI? Insurance Claims Adjusters
context: Of the Glassdoor reviews from claims adjusters that mentioned AI, a staggering 98 percent were negative. “AI is just a tool,” one person tells WIRED. “It should never be given the keys.”
